policy: query params are sorted by name (stable - the value order of a repeated name is preserved) and re-encoded canonically; tracking params are dropped: any param starting utm_ plus exactly {gclid, fbclid, msclkid} - EXCEPT utm_content, which is KEPT (it routes the A/B feature experience, per the marketing-eng agreement); params with an empty value are dropped entirely (that rule wins even for utm_content); scheme and host are lowercased while the path keeps its case AND its trailing slash exactly as given (case-sensitive origin object storage; /dir/ vs /dir are different resources)
bug_report: Since the ad campaign launched, the edge cache hit-rate has cratered and the CDN bill nearly doubled - origin egress is spiking on pages that should be cached. Separately, two customers report seeing someone else's experiment variant on pages our analytics says belong to the other cohort. A failing repro is at tests/test_regression.py. Fix cache_key so equivalent requests share a cache entry, without breaking existing behaviour.
